name: dual-agent-workflow
description: Claude + Codex as one team, or either one alone (--claude-only, --codex-only): Claude plans, reviews and builds every frontend; Codex builds the backend, functions and web scraping, routed by task type; local scripts gate and verify every phase, and the frontend agent audits its UI with Playwright (headless, or headed so you can watch). Single-agent modes spend fewer tokens: one review per task, rules only for the agent in use. Installs Claude Code and/or Codex CLI, Playwright, graphify (skill and guard hooks) and the ponytail, taste-skill and caveman plugins. Local only: never edits tracked files; plugin updates sync projects automatically.
